podcasts.script: Quick one for listeners in London. Blue Social is an independent supporters' group launching free big-screen match nights and a five-a-side tournament for Chelsea and Premier League fans. It kicks off Friday, December 18. It's all ages and costs nothing, so watch the match with a crowd that cares as much as you do, then get out on the pitch yourself. Put a team together and sign up at {link}. That's Blue Social, from Friday, December 18: {link}.

podcasts.name: Monday Morning Podcast
podcasts.script: London, listen up. If you're a Chelsea or Premier League fan watching the match alone on your sofa, there's a better way. Blue Social is an independent supporters' group running free big-screen match nights, plus a five-a-side tournament so you can find out whether your legs still work. It starts Friday, December 18. It's all ages and it's free. Get your mates together and sign up at {link}. Again, that's {link}.

partners.subject: Blue Social match nights: base the street team at Moca caffee?
partners.body: Hi Moca caffee team, we're Blue Social, an independent supporters' group launching free big-screen match nights and a five-a-side tournament for Chelsea and Premier League fans across London, starting Friday, December 18 (all ages). Taste data shows your visitors closely match people who love Chelsea F.C. and the Premier League, and since you're open seven days including weekends, you'd be a great base for our Greenwich street team. Could our small team meet at yours before heading out with flyers? We'd love to offer [your offer, e.g. a shout-out on our match-night screens]. Details are here: {link}. Thanks, and we hope to hear from you!

partners.subject: Host a Blue Social sign-up pop-up at The Big Plate Cafe?
partners.body: Hi The Big Plate Cafe team, we're Blue Social, an independent supporters' group launching free big-screen match nights and a five-a-side tournament for Chelsea and Premier League fans across London, starting Friday, December 18 (all ages). Taste data shows your visitors closely match people who love Chelsea F.C. and the Premier League, and a sit-down café like yours suits a small screening or a tournament sign-up pop-up. Would you be open to hosting one? We'd love to offer [your offer, e.g. featuring your cafe in our match-night promotion]. More info here: {link}. Cheers, and we hope to chat soon!
